lines.trans: Pavel Yuryevich, this is urgent! I must tell you.
I have no time. Say what you want to say.
I love you! Deeply!
Really? How so?
I understand I'm no match for you. You're a handsome man, and I'm old.
Lydia Alexeyevna, calm down, please! You're behaving like a little girl.

words.gloss: a little girl (lit. a small one)

lines.trans: I'm asking you, calm down! Everything will be fine.
Maybe some medicine? Do you need medicine?
Forgive me! Forgive and forget! Do you promise me?
This is my womanly honour, after all! Do you promise?
I promise! I promise!
Thank you!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

вести.gloss: to lead, to conduct (вести себя = to behave)

meanings.en: to lead, to guide, to drive
вести себя: to behave, to conduct oneself
meanings.note: Вы как маленькая себя ведёте = You're behaving like a little girl

examples.trans: You're behaving like a little girl.
I can see the toy car.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence

meanings.en: after all, still, all the same

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.trans: This is my womanly honour, after all!
Don't forget to wash the toilet.
I was held up at work.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know
declines like какой: какая-то, какое-то, какие-то

examples.trans: Right now, you see, I'm making copies.
I need a copy of this document.

meanings.note: fleeting е in declined forms: красавца, красавцу...
affectionately about an impressive object or animal, still declined as animate

examples.trans: See what a beauty they've brought!
The doctor prescribed a new medicine.
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
мне некогда = I have no time

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence
short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job
+ dative of the person: обещать вам

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)
match (in a relationship: я не пара вам = I'm no match for you)

examples.text: Я понимаю, я не пара вам.
examples.trans: I understand I'm no match for you.
They are a very handsome couple.

подниматься.gloss: to go up, to climb, to rise

meanings.en: to go upstairs, to climb, to ascend

examples.trans: We are going up the stairs.

meanings.note: понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness

examples.trans: The wind is blowing hard outside.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent

examples.trans: I need to make a phone call urgently.

угодно.gloss: as you like, any- (in как угодно, что угодно)

meanings.en: pleasing, as one wishes (used with question words: как угодно = any way you like, что угодно = anything at all)

examples.trans: I don't know, any way you like!

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.en: to calm down, to settle down

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.note: Ваша честь = courtroom address to a judge

examples.text: Ваша честь, у нас есть заявление.
examples.trans: Your Honour, we have a statement.
It is a matter of honour.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
